## Current Focus

I focus on work that turns complex football questions into practical
decision-support tools: scouting, recruitment, and performance analysis.
My approach combines qualitative video analysis with quantitative data
work, letting Sportscode observations lead the analysis while data serves
as supporting evidence.

## Highlights

- Six-month football analytics program benchmarking **Brøndby IF** (Danish Superliga)
- Built a full **SofaScore + Sportscode data pipeline** for opposition and player analysis
- **Four-corner scout dossiers** combining percentile charts, heatmaps, shot maps and pass maps
- Video scouting reports produced in DaVinci Resolve with tactical animation in TacticalPad
